scientific_integrity: Proof is an explicit affine-map classification and transfer calculation. The checker operates on actual finite partial maps; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts idempotent-first commuting pairs only; not a census of all commuting pairs. Historical priority remains qualified by partial accessibility of older literature. Finite checks corroborate the all-size proof.
title: Parity-sensitive rank spectra of idempotent commutants in full order-decreasing partial-isometry monoids
